subject: Television & Streaming
title: Netflix's Cultural Impact
description: A short lesson to help you apply Netflix's Cultural Impact.

hook.text: Netflix and chill became a phrase. An entire generation's social life now revolves around a streaming app.

buildup.text: The platform launched global hits like Squid Game and Wednesday that would never have aired on traditional TV.

discovery.text: Netflix spent $17 billion on content in a single year—more than most countries spend on their entire film industries.

twist.text: Critics argue Netflix floods the market with mediocre content. The strategy is volume, not curation.

climax.text: Love it or hate it, Netflix redefined how the world consumes stories. There is no going back.

punchline.text: One company rewrote the rules of global entertainment.

quiz.question: How much did Netflix spend on content in its peak spending year?
